body:
Founder real-time, 2026-09-08: 'the alpine pi installable parena powered emily os.' Updates PARENA_COREUTILS_NORTHSTAR.md's Phase 5 entry from explicitly-deferred to decided: parenabusybox/parenash now cross-compiled for aarch64 and staged into the real EmilyOS Pi image, available-not-default (turbogrep/turbosed precedent held). Full implementation in EmilyOS (commit 5582db9); this commit is the doc-side record including the musl/glibc ABI gap found and fixed along the way. Commit 7c5513e.

⚓ ☃
title: Phase 5 founder call made: coreutils/shell staged into EmilyOS Pi image
